headSubject: feat(kernel): built-in geo capability -- distance and nearest with no code (geo-inproc); the AI briefing teaches it
summary: 2026-11-11 (seventh part): owner asked for fewer gates, more development (memory fewer-gates-more-development). aiKnowledge gate PASSED on the final tree (56/56, 857 s); T4.1 committed c520b052. Published the 12 built-in packs + catalog-index.json to the public MarceloGiazzon/NPR (staged on a local remote first; user-1.0.0 tag added; npdev pack search finds 13; a model importing contacts from NPR resolves and validates). Built the ride-hailing sample S1 in AppGen/apps/ride-hailing-s1 (outside the repo; a Java-capability variant is kept in ride-hailing-s1-javacap, port 8151) and drove it over REST: 14/14 checks. That exposed REG-327 (a saving flow without persistence declared validates but the app does not boot) -- opened, owner decision derive-vs-report pending. Briefing: docs/content/authoring-for-ai.yml gained Reuse and extend (packs, fragments, saving flows, procedures with queried rows, customCapabilities, http-connector, geo), compact bundle 16.6k -> 22.8k chars, relay-prompts.json untouched. Owner chose option A: geo as a PLATFORM capability -- new adapter module NPDevKernel/adapters/geo-inproc (distanceKm, closest), wired like mail-inproc, 8 tests, committed 75621ba3. User Java cannot travel through the relay until T4.4 (code quarantine, not built; apply refuses answers carrying code; fragments denied in phase mvp).
nextStep: FIRST: the owner runs the real Uber test with a chat AI in the browser (only they can). Before that, remeasure the bench arm for the grown briefing (scripts/ai/bench, arm relay; bundle now 22.8k chars vs the ≤5k tokens/app goal; never edit platform Java while it runs). THEN: decide REG-327 (platform derives persistence binding when a flow saves, preferred, or validate reports it); decide whether the relay default phase becomes f4 so fragments are accepted (Manager passes no phase today); S2 payments pack + surge (no payments pack exists; surge could be a pack or a derivedExpression); promote S1 into NPDevSamples with a corpusRole entry and a behaviour probe if the owner wants it kept; then T4.2 upsert, T4.4 code quarantine (large, security), a relay path for AI-authored pack.json. Gates: run the full aiKnowledge gate at most once a day or before a release; geo-inproc and the RuntimeHost default-profile manifest were NOT covered by a T2 gate.
verified: geo-inproc 8 tests; generator manifest+binding tests 2; twin-pair, cited-paths, doc-inventory, ledger checkers; ride-hailing S1 14/14 over REST with the new jar; aiKnowledge gate PASSED earlier on the T4.1 tree
